Alger, 4 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 4, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Home Energy Hydrocarbons: American company KBR wants to strengthen its presence in Algeria Energy Front page Hydrocarbons: American company KBR wants to strengthen its presence in Algeria By: AE Editorial Team Date: September 3, 2026 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp The Minister of State, Minister of Hydrocarbons, Mohamed Arkab, received on Wednesday
Les discussions ont porté sur les perspe: Discussions focused on the prospects for developing KBR's activities in Algeria and on several areas of cooperation, notably engineering, project management, and technologies applied to the energy sector. According to the ministry, KBR expressed its interest in supporting Sonatrach by placing its technical expertise, management capabilities, and technologies at its disposal, particularly in upstream oil and gas activities. The stated objective is notably to contribute to the development of oil and gas production capacities, as well as petrochemical activities.
Une relation avec Sonatrach qui remonte: A relationship with Sonatrach dating back to the 1980s During the meeting, KBR representatives recalled the group's experience in Algeria and its relations with Sonatrach, which date back to the early 1980s. The American company has notably participated in the construction of several industrial facilities, including liquefied natural gas infrastructure in Skikda and Arzew. It has also contributed to projects related to gas and oil processing, ammonia production, as well as the renovation and modernization of industrial facilities.
KBR souhaite désormais faire de l’Algéri: KBR now wishes to make Algeria "a priority market in North Africa". The group also indicated its willingness to establish a dedicated engineering and project management structure in Algeria. This structure could rely on local and international skills and resources.
Le gouvernement mise sur le transfert de: The government is betting on technology transfer For his part, Mohamed Arkab insisted on the importance of developing partnerships with international companies and taking advantage of their technologies and know-how. The minister notably highlighted the necessity of modernizing energy and industrial infrastructure while strengthening local content and knowledge transfer. He thus invited KBR to examine the opportunities offered by the Algerian market and to take part in investment projects, particularly in gas development, processing industries, and new technologies.
La délégation américaine a, pour sa part: The American delegation, for its part, confirmed its interest in strengthening its activities in Algeria and its willingness to participate in industrial and investment projects. KBR stated it is ready to mobilize its engineering capabilities and technologies to support Algerian programs and continue its cooperation with Sonatrach and national companies.
